text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Aoharu Cup"—a team competition held 
in the past where teams competed across 
five categories: Sprint, Mile, Medium, 
Long, and Dirt.
color_text_info_list: Sprint, Mile, Medium, Long, and Dirt

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unlike official competitions, it doesn't 
affect their records. Even so, they shared 
joys and sorrows, clashed, and encouraged 
one another. It was a tournament that 
offered such a passionate experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Taiki Shuttle's earnest plea, 
Director Akikawa decides to revive the 
Aoharu Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Director Akikawa's sudden 
overseas business trip is scheduled, 
leaving the management of the Aoharu Cup 
to the newly appointed Acting Director.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just what kind of person could the Acting 
Director really be...?"
